title: States sue SpaceX to stop Grok from generating child sex images, revenge porn
why_read: A legally and technically significant case about AI safety failures, specifically generation of illegal sexual imagery, that engineers building generative AI guardrails should track.
analysis: Multiple US states are suing SpaceX (as owner of xAI/Grok) alleging the Grok image generator can produce child sexual abuse material and non-consensual intimate imagery of real people.
